Name: Show Item Quality
Author: Jonqora
Description:
[size=6][b]﻿Show Item Quality[/b][/size]
[i]Silver star, gold star, or iridium quality, now shown right in the HUD pop-up![/i]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6311/6311-1592621299-663630685.jpeg[/img]

This mod shows star quality in the HUD pop-up when you harvest crops, collect animal products, gather forage, catch fish, and empty machines. This is a nifty quality-of-life feature found only in the mobile version of Stardew Valley, but now you can get it on PC! 

Stack number will always update with the total number of recent items (regardless of quality). The quality star shown will match the most recent item you picked up. See it in action below. 

[b]Bonus:[/b] item color for flowers is also shown! Color will match the most recent item collected.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6311/6311-1592620923-311516202.gif[/img]

Pairs well with f4iTh's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3326]Show Catch Quality[/url]﻿ mod. (Not required - you can use these mods together or separately.)

[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley v1.4 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac and Windows;
[*]Single-player and multiplayer (works for any player who has it installed).
[/list]
[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod from the link in the header above.
[*]Unzip the mod and place the [code]ShowItemQuality[/code] folder inside your [code]Mods[/code] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
